title: Kirby Problem 1.68
exact_target: Which smooth knot types have at least one Legendrian representative with an orientable exact Lagrangian filling?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2727 (KP-1.68). CC BY 4.0.
